title: Demand Estimation Using Managerial Responses to Automated Price Recommendations
eligible_reason: Not a staggered adoption design. The 'difference-in-differences' (Table 6) regresses booking changes on the price change (rate_diff, continuous) interacted with an indicator for whether the manager's update matched the software recommendation (dnd_treat), with panel FE. The shipped data are simulated.
design_notes: full-simulation-code.R: double-selection lasso regressions of bookings on prices (Table 5 code at line 166f with original data), lm(booking_diff ~ rate_diff + rate_diff*dnd_treat + dnd_treat) on simulated data (original felm versions with panelid FE are commented out at line 246f). double_selected_simulation.m generates the simulated baseline model for Table EC.1.
data_access: proprietary (revenue-management software provider data; not shipped)
data_files_note: readme.pdf: the CSVs are simulated data for the baseline model in Table EC.1, not the original data.
software_notes: R 4.0.2 (lm, felm, glmnet/hdm); MATLAB 2019a for the simulation.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text in data/text). Package contents read, no code run.
